h1: The 6 Best Locking Filing Cabinets of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Locking File Cabinets 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six metal filing cabinets with confirmed locks, from under $50 to $200, compared on drawers, folder fit and footprint.
summary: The Letaya 3-drawer mobile cabinet is our top pick because it arrives assembled and rolls under a desk. The Letaya lateral cabinet suits wall runs, the SISESOL is the cheapest under-desk option, and the Livofloral gives the most drawers with two locks.
intro: The lock on a filing cabinet is only as useful as the folders it lets you store. A cabinet can have a perfectly good key and still not take legal-size hanging files, which forces you to buy again.

We reviewed six metal cabinets whose listings confirm a lock. We left out a tall garage storage cabinet that is not designed for hanging folders, and a rolling cabinet with no confirmed lock. Ranking is based on the spec sheet: lock confirmation, drawer count, folder sizes, footprint and assembly.

products.name: Letaya 3 Drawer Mobile File Cabinet with Lock, Under Desk Metal Filing Cabinet
products.verdict: Three locking drawers that roll under a desk, no assembly needed.
products.description:
The Letaya has three drawers, a confirmed lock, caster wheels and a black metal finish. It arrives fully assembled and takes letter, legal and A4 hanging folders.

It beats the two-drawer picks because it adds a third drawer without growing much in footprint, and arriving assembled saves an evening of work. It costs more than the SISESOL.

Ideal for a home office with limited floor space. The caveat is that casters can roll if the floor is uneven, so lock them when loaded.
products.idealFor: Home offices that need compact rolling storage.
products.skipIf: You want a wall-hugging lateral layout.

products.name: Letaya 2 Drawer File Cabinet with Lock, Metal Lateral Filing Cabinet
products.verdict: A wide, low cabinet that sits neatly along a wall.
products.description:
This lateral cabinet is about 28 inches wide with two drawers, a confirmed lock and room for letter, legal and A4 hanging folders.

It ranks under the 3-drawer Letaya because it has fewer drawers and no casters, but the wide layout puts files within easy reach and the top can hold a printer.

Suits a wall run in a spare room. The caveat is the width, so measure the wall first.
products.idealFor: Wall runs in a spare room.
products.skipIf: You need to slide it under a desk.

products.name: SISESOL 2 Drawer File Cabinet with Lock, Narrow Vertical Filing Cabinet
products.verdict: The cheapest locking cabinet here and still narrow enough for most desks.
products.description:
The SISESOL is a narrow two-drawer vertical cabinet with a confirmed lock. It handles letter, A4 and legal files and fits under most desks. It is in the under $50 bucket.

It ranks below the Letaya cabinets because the build is simpler and assembly is required, but nothing else locks for less.

Good for a first home file. The caveat is that cheap steel gauges may flex when drawers are full.
products.idealFor: First-time buyers on a tight budget.

products.name: BYNSOE 2 Drawer File Cabinet with Lock, Vertical Filing Storage Cabinet
products.verdict: A plain steel cabinet with a lock and letter-size drawers.
products.description:
The BYNSOE is a two-drawer vertical steel cabinet with a confirmed lock and assembly required. It is rated for letter-size files.

It ranks under the SISESOL because that one lists legal and A4 fit as well and costs less, while this one sits in the $50-100 bucket.

Pick it if you only file letter-size paper. The caveat is the lack of legal-size support.

products.name: SteeLoong 2 Drawer File Cabinet with Lock, Metal Office File Cabinet
products.verdict: A compact two-drawer metal cabinet for small offices.
products.description:
SteeLoong offers two metal drawers, a confirmed lock and a compact footprint in black. Assembly is required.

It ranks below the BYNSOE because the listing names no folder sizes, so you must check fit yourself.

Buy it for a small home office. The caveat is that unclear folder fit means a quick check of the drawer dimensions.
products.idealFor: Small home offices with little floor space.

products.name: Livofloral Vertical File Cabinet with 4 Drawers and 1 Door, 2 Locks
products.verdict: Four drawers and a door with two separate locks.
products.description:
The Livofloral has four drawers plus a lockable door in a white metal finish, with two confirmed locks. It fits letter, legal and A4 folders and needs assembly.

It ranks last because it is tall, takes real floor space and has the thinnest track record on paper, but nothing else here stores as much.

Buy it for a growing paper archive. The caveat is that two locks mean two keys to keep track of.

whatMatters.detail: Most cabinet locks are simple keyed cylinders that deter casual access, not a determined thief. They keep kids and visitors out. Check the listing says the lock is included, and ask how many keys come in the box.
Letter folders are the standard in the US, legal folders are longer, and A4 is slightly narrower and taller. A drawer that fits only letter will not take legal files. Look for the sizes by name.
Vertical cabinets are deep and narrow, while lateral ones are wide and shallow. Lateral fits wall runs and vertical fits corners. Measure your space before choosing.
More drawers mean more storage per square foot of floor. Taller cabinets get less stable when top drawers are open. Check for an anti-tilt design.
Flat-pack cabinets take an hour or more and can end up slightly racked. Pre-assembled ones arrive ready. The listing says which type it is.

faq.a: They deter casual access, not a determined break-in. For critical papers, consider a fireproof safe as well.
Ignoring folder size. Legal hanging files will not fit a letter-only drawer.

faq.q: Is a lateral cabinet worth it?
faq.a: If you have a wall to fill, yes. It gives easy reach and a work surface, but needs wide floor space.
Flat-pack models usually take about an hour. The Letaya 3 Drawer arrives assembled.

faq.q: How do I stop a cabinet tipping?
faq.a: Open one drawer at a time and keep heavy files low. Anchor tall cabinets to the wall.

faq.q: What if I lose the key?
faq.a: Contact the seller for a replacement. Keep a spare key in a separate safe place.

finalTake: The Letaya 3 Drawer is the best locking filing cabinet for most home offices since it arrives assembled and fits under a desk. Pick the Letaya lateral for wall runs, the SISESOL for the lowest price, or the Livofloral if you need the most storage. Check folder size before buying.
